paite: Joshua sih nung in hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante'n, "Kanaante dou a ei a dia hon sualsak ding in kua akuantou masa dia?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi.
heading: Judah Leh Simeon Namte'n Adoni-bezek Aman Uh

paite: TOUPA'N, "Judah va kuan hen. Ngai un, akhut ah gam ka peta," achi hi.
Judah in a-unau Simeon kiang ah, "Kanaante dou ding in ka gam tantuam ah hong paitou in. Kei leng na gam tantuam ah ka hong pai sam ding," achi hi. Huchi in Simeon akiang ah ahohta hi.
Huchi in Judah ava hoh a; Kanaante leh Perizte TOUPA'N akhut uah apeta hi. Bezek ah mi singkhat athat uhi.
Bezek ah Adoni- bezek amu ua, adou ua, Kanaante leh Perizte athat uhi.
Himahleh Adoni-bezek atai a; anungdelh ua, aman ua, akhutpi leh akhepi atansak uhi.

Adoni-bezek in, "Kumpipa sawmsagihte khutpi leh khepi ka tankhiaksakte'n ka dohkan nuai ah anneng atawm uh. Ka hih bang geih a Pathian in hon thuk ahita ve," achi hi. Jerusalem ah api ua, huai ah asita hi.
Judah suante'n Jerusalem khua dou in ala ua, namsau a sual in akhopi ahal uhi.
heading: Judah Nam In Jerusalem Leh Hebron Azou

paite: Huai nung in Judah suante tanggam simlam leh phaizang a teng Kanaante dou ding in akuansuk uhi.
Judah in Kanaante Hebron a tengte ava dou a, (ama in Hebron min Kiriath-arba ahi) Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai athat uhi.
Huai a pan Debir khomite adou uh, ama in Debir kho min Kiriath-sepher ahi.
heading: Othniel In Debir Khopi Azou / (Jos 15.13-19)

paite: Kaleb in, "Kuapeuh Kiriath-sepher khua dou a, la peuhmah ka tanu Aksah azi ding in ka pe ding," achi hi.
Kaleb nau Kenaji tapa Othniel in alazou a, azi ding in atanu Aksah apeta hi.
uan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ava tun in gam ngen thei ding in apa akunzou hi. Sabiltung a pan akumkhia a; Kaleb in akiang ah, "Bang na deih a?" achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Hon vualzawl in. Simlam gam lah na hon peta ngal a, tui nak neite leng hon pe lai in," achi hi. Kaleb in tui nak nei tungnungte leh khangnungte apeta hi.
Mosi puzon Ken suante Arad simlam a om Judah gamdai ah Judah suante toh tum sing khopi a pan ahohtou ua; mipite lak ah ava teng uhi.
heading: Judah Leh Benjamin Namte Vualzohnate

paite: Judah bel a-unau Simeon toh akisa ua, Zephath a om Kanaante ava that ua, ahihchimit vek uhi. Huai khopi min Hormah chih ahi.
Judah in Gaza khua leh abialte, Ashkelon khua leh abialte leh Ekron khua leh abialte tan in ala hi.
TOUPA Judah kiang ah a-om a; tanggam a tengte adelhkhia a; phaizang a tengte bel sik kangtalaite aneih ziak un adelhkhe zou kei hi.
Mosi in ana gensa bang in Hebron khua Kaleb apia ua, ama'n huai a pan Anak tapa thumte adelhkhia hi.
Benjamin suante'n Jebuste, Jerusalem a tengte adelhkhe kei ua, Jebuste Benjamin suante toh tuni tan in Jerusalem ah atengkhawm uhi.
Joseph inkuante leng Bethel khua dou ding in akisatou ua, akiang uah TOUPA a-om hi.
heading: Epraim Leh Manasseh Nam In Bethel Azou

paite: Joseph inkuante'n Bethel ah enkhe mite asawl uhi. Ama in huai kho min Luz ahi.
Enkhe mite'n mi khat khosung a pan hong pawtkhia amu ua, akiang ah, "Hehpih in khopi sung lutna hon ensak dih ve, huchi in ka hon hehpih ding uh," achi uhi,
Khopi sung lutna a-ensak a, namsau in huai khua adou ua; huai mipa leh a-inkuanpihte teng bel ahinghawi uhi,
Huai mipa Hitte gam a lut in khua asat a, huai kho min Luz asa a; tuni tan in hiai min apu lai hi.

Manasseh in Beth-shean khua leh akhopel a tengte, Taanak khua leh akhopel a tengte, Dor khua leh akhopel a tengte, Ibleam khua leh akhopel a tengte, Meggiddo khua leh akhopel a tengte adelhkhe kei hi. Huai gam ah Kanaante ateng uhi.
heading: Israel Mite'n Ahawlkhiak Louh Mite

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante ahong hat un anasem ding un Kanaante a omsak ua, adelhkhe siang vek kei uhi.
Ephraim in Gezer a teng Kanaante adelhkhe kei a; Gezer ah alak uah Kanaante ateng zawta uh.
Zebulun in Kitron a tengte leh Nahalol a tengte adelhkhe kei a; Kanaante alak uah ateng sam ua, anasem ding un a-om zawta uhi.
Asher in Akko a tengte, Zidon a tengte, Ahlab a tengte, Akjib a tengte, Helbah a tengte, Aphik a tengte leh Rehob a tengte adelhkhe kei hi.
Asher suante huai gam a teng Kanaante lak ah ateng samta uhi; amau lah adelhkhe ngal kei ua.
Naphtali in Beth-shemesh a tengte, Beth-anath a tengte adelhkhe kei. Huai gam a teng Kanaante lak ah ateng samta uhi. Beth-shemesh a tengte leh Beth-anath a tengte nasem ding in a-omta uhi.
Amorte'n Dan suante tanggam ah ahawltou uh; phaizang a apaisuk uh aphal ngal kei ua.
Amorte Aijalon a Heres tang leh Shaalbim ah ateng ua, Joseph inkuante'n amau azou ua, anasem ding un alak uah ateng uhi.
Amorte gam chiang Akrabbim tungkahna a pan, suangpi a pan leh Sela a pan ahi.
